## Problem / motivation

What problem does this feature solve? Who would benefit?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see implemented? Include API sketches or kernel call sites if relevant.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've considered and why they're less preferable.

## Compatibility

- Does this require kernel ABI changes? (sysfs, ioctl, module params)
- Does this affect compatibility with the proprietary AMI components?
- Does this affect compatibility with other cloud / onprem deployments?

## Additional context

Links to related upstream patches, papers, prior art.
